# 🪝 Hooks

Hooks run a script when something happens in a session: it starts, a tool is about to run, a file was edited.

| Tool | How to install |
| --- | --- |
| Claude Code | Each hook is its own plugin: `/plugin install <hook>@jaktestowac`. Needs Node.js on your PATH. |
| GitHub Copilot | Copy the hook's folder from [`copilot/.github/hooks/`](copilot/.github/hooks/) into your project's `.github/hooks/`. The bash scripts need `jq`; PowerShell needs nothing extra. |
| OpenAI Codex | Not supported yet: Codex only runs plugin hooks for manually installed desktop plugins. |

## Hooks

| Hook | What it does | Claude Code | Copilot |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: |
| `always-on-skills` | Keeps always-apply skill invariants, such as unslop-tests, in force for the whole session, and restates the relevant one after each edit to a file in its scope. | [plugin](../plugins/always-on-skills/) | [folder](copilot/.github/hooks/always-on-skills/) |
| `print-tool-info` | Shows the tool name, arguments, time and working directory before each tool call. Useful for learning how hooks work and for debugging what an agent does. | [plugin](../plugins/print-tool-info/) | [folder](copilot/.github/hooks/print-tool-info/) |
